question: Into how many parts must the height be divided using the lotus-measure half-part?
premises: The height is the dimension to be divided.
The division is performed using the lotus-measure half-part.
The total number of divisions is twenty-two.
inference: The height should be divided into twenty-two parts using the half-part of the lotus measure.
plain_english: Divide the height into twenty-two parts, using the half-part of the lotus measure.
